procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. Tender fee NIL in the table (though the Tender Fee and EMD paragraph refers to 'Fee as per NIT' by DD). EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalised bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening; originals by 07.08.2024 15:00.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Open to lift manufacturing agencies without joint venture, or regular civil engineering contractors in joint venture consortium with a lift manufacturer

(A) Lift manufacturer with valid licence/registration from state CEIG or other state/central licensing authority and experience in fabrication/erection of steel structural towers for lifts and lift installation to minimum 30 m height; OR (B) contractor with valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL etc. in JV with a lift manufacturer

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%; only fully completed works with completion certificate; values enhanced at 7% simple per annum; certificates below Executive Engineer rank not considered

Similar works: fabrication and erection of steel structural tower for lift and installation of lift to minimum 30 m height, and any civil engineering works (RCC towers, steel structures, buildings, bridges, dams, water tanks); lift manufacturer's (second party) experience counted; second party to submit manufacturing licence / CEIG certificate
PAN/ITCC/GST registration; bank solvency certificate from a scheduled bank for 40% of estimated cost

Average annual financial turnover on construction works (CA certified) at least 30% of estimated cost over last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2023; P&L and audited balance sheets for past five years
Income tax returns and sales tax clearance for last three years; litigation/blacklisting information for last 5 years; key personnel; list of tools & plants and shuttering materials

Tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); unconditional bid undertaking (Annexure III); non-blacklisting affidavit; list of relatives in MoPSW/DGLL; Make in India self-certification (Annexure VII); documents per Section IX technical evaluation criteria
